title: 깊고 얇은 W2 가지와 L1·분광 손실, 관측 일치 사영 결합
hypothesis: Depth of the half-resolution W2 branch gave the largest RR gain per operation (75: 64x4 -> 64x8 +0.394 dB for +4.8 GMAC), but no W2 deeper than 8 blocks was tried. A deeper, narrower W2 (64 x 12: 34.9 GMAC, 59% of C2MS; 64 x 16: 39.8 GMAC, 67%) may keep most of the C2MS gain, and the two inference-cost-free gains already measured on C2MS (65 L1 + spectral loss: SAM -0.100 deg on 60/60 scenes; 66 observation-consistency projection: about +0.04 dB on every seed; together +0.072 dB / -0.102 deg / -0.027 against 53 C2MS over three seeds, post hoc) can lift it above C2MS with fewer operations.

evidence.loss_65: C2MS + L1 + spectral, QB 3 seeds vs 53: RR +0.028 dB, SAM -0.100 deg (60/60 scenes), ERGAS -0.008
evidence.projection_66: projection at inference: about +0.04 dB per seed; 65 + projection vs 53 C2MS, 3 seeds: +0.072 dB / -0.102 deg / -0.027; vs C2MS + projection +0.033 dB
evidence.lesson_78: ensemble gain did not transfer by output distillation, so this experiment uses only gains already measured on single models

arms.C2MS_W64D12_L1S: original SSA-MRN K4 + W2 64 channels x 12 blocks (75 SizedParallel), 65 loss; 1,346,014 parameters (used 1,227,706), 34.94 GMAC
arms.C2MS_W64D16_L1S: original SSA-MRN K4 + W2 64 channels x 16 blocks, 65 loss; 1,641,438 parameters (used 1,523,130), 39.77 GMAC

projection: 45/66 y' = y + D^T M^T (M D D^T M^T)^-1 M (MS - D y), interior margin 5, CG per band in float64 (tol 1e-8, at most 400 iterations), applied after every inference (prepare.Projected); parameter-free; GPU time measured at evaluation
loss: original per-pixel L1 + 1.0 x per-pixel L1 on 2x coarser pairs + 0.46 x spectral loss (58: mean over pixels of 1 - cos between predicted and GT band vectors, zero-norm pixels skipped) on the original pair; history fields train_mse/coarse_train_mse hold mean absolute errors
ema_note: the 58 trainer records EMA weights (beta 0.99) as in 65; selection uses the online weights (validation MSE), EMA weights are recorded only

comparisons.official: arm + projection vs plain 53 C2MS of the same seed (criteria v2.4, RR only)
comparisons.structure: arm vs 65 C2MS_L1S (same loss and data, C2MS branch), raw and projected
comparisons.reference: 65 + projection vs 53 (reproduces 66), 53 + projection vs 53, arm vs original 43 C0 (share of the C2MS gain)

stages.stage1: QB seed 42, both arms at once
stages.stage1_gate: fixed before training (evaluate.stage_gate): an arm passes when arm + projection beats plain C2MS on all three RR metrics at seed 42; if both pass the one with fewer operations (64 x 12) goes on; if none passes, stage 2 is not run
stages.stage2: the chosen arm, QB seeds 43 and 44 at once; judgement = mean of the three same-seed pairs (v2.4, threshold 0.04 dB)
stages.lightweight_reference: reported, not a judgement: 3-seed mean RR PSNR of arm + projection at or above C2MS - 0.04 dB counts as non-inferior
stages.automation: run.py runs stage 1, the gate and stage 2 in one controller; nothing is tuned between the stages

expected_duration: stage 1 about 6 h (two at once), stage 2 about 6 h, plus evaluations with the projection
limits: single-seed stage 1 screen with an exploratory reuse of the test set for the gate
the projection could also be applied to C2MS itself; both comparisons are reported
deeper branches add sequential layers, and the projection adds an iterative step, so the measured GPU time can move against the operation count
precision: FP16 AMP core training with GradScaler; FP32 transforms, loss, validation and evaluation (as 53/63)
selection: minimum original-scale validation MSE including epoch 0, earliest exact tie; test never used for selection (same rule as 53/65)
